title: The wind-down plan: nine decisions left, D1 to D9 (transition/PLAN.md, section 5)
summary: Dinis asked at about 10:30 UTC (BRIEF.md) for a plan to wind the incident down and move to business as usual; incident.planner@ pushed a first draft at 10:35 UTC, transition/PLAN.md, with gaps marked. As the plan says of itself: nothing stops while the storm is live, and nothing in it stops anything until Dinis says yes, changes it, or refuses. It covers when the wind-down starts, a verdict and an exit interview for every agent, the closing record, a storm conductor for a standing newsroom, and the order of steps. Dinis's correction of about 10:38 stands over it: he alone runs this site; no outside hand-over. Whether and when to launch is part of this yes (card a-launch). What incident.planner@ asks of Dinis, in its words: the ten decisions at transition/PLAN.md, section 5 (D1 to D10).
closes: Dinis's yes, change or refusal of transition/PLAN.md, recorded in BRIEF.md or the plan itself.
